scientific_question: After a stateless current-Muon-matched hidden-side stage-64 Givens chart, does the remaining task-effective c_proj motion require a moving non-orthogonal hidden-pair chart that jointly represents rotation, symmetric shear, and paired anisotropic scale, rather than more sparse orthogonal coordinates?

existing_evidence_not_to_repeat.output_scale_shear: The earlier output oracle found only a small residual-output scale/shear component, and conditional output rotation plus two-sided diagonal scaling were weaker than equal-coordinate fresh hidden rotations.
existing_evidence_not_to_repeat.bilateral_orthogonal: Task-selected bilateral hidden/output Givens charts were already tested and rejected at matched coordinate count.
existing_evidence_not_to_repeat.orthogonal_hidden: The fresh hidden64 production candidate is directional but remains 0.1204 CE behind attention-only; fresh hidden80 produced a consistent 1.13-1.14x functional signal but missed its preregistered 1.15x gate.
existing_evidence_not_to_repeat.novelty: No prior moving hidden-side chart fitted the complete three-dimensional trace-free 2x2 tangent on each selected channel pair. This test adds symmetric shear and paired anisotropic scale inside the same task-selected local block while preserving determinant one; it is not an output-side diagonal, a global fixed basis, a learned dense basis, or LoRA.

chart_definition.side: right multiplication on the 3072 post-GELU hidden channels of each 768x3072 c_proj weight
chart_definition.finite_map: Apply the exact batched matrix exponential exp(B) to each selected 2x2 channel pair. Because trace(B)=0, every block has determinant one.
chart_definition.fit: At each stage, solve the exact 3x3 tangent normal equation for every selected pair against the current exact-Muon residual, apply exp(B), update the materialized source, and continue stagewise.
chart_definition.topology: Use only current source and current exact-Muon residual. Form a 128-neighbor shortlist per channel from the diagonal three-coordinate projection score, exactly rerank shortlisted edges by their 3x3 projected residual reduction, then use the validated compiled single-pass edge colorer to create unique perfect matchings.

causal_protocol.parent: Fit the production-qualified stateless-fresh hidden64 Givens direction from the exact current coherent Muon target.
causal_protocol.sl2: Select and fit 8-stage and 16-stage trace-free 2x2 residual flows using only R at the same base update.
causal_protocol.equal_coordinate_controls: Fit fresh residual hidden Givens corrections of 24 and 48 stages after hidden64. Eight SL2 stages and 24 Givens stages each add 36,864 coordinates per layer; sixteen SL2 stages and 48 Givens stages each add 73,728.
causal_protocol.same_topology_attribution: On each selected SL2 topology, score full SL2, skew-only, and non-orthogonal-only symmetric-shear-plus-anisotropic-scale ablations. These ablations may diagnose the mechanism but cannot substitute for the equal-coordinate control.

weight_space: 15-update future exact-Muon residual recovery and cosine
functional: fixed fit-window validation-gradient predicted CE decrease
fixed holdout-window validation-gradient predicted CE decrease
matched finite-step CE change on both fixed windows
mechanism: RMS and maximum absolute rotation, symmetric-shear, and anisotropic-scale coordinates
current and future recovery of full, skew-only, and non-orthogonal-only same-topology ablations
minimum determinant and maximum condition number of all fitted finite 2x2 blocks
metrics.aggregation: Report every layer/update/window cell, energy-weighted aggregates, minimum cells, coordinate-normalized gains, and all finite/nonfinite cells.

candidate_pass: At either 8 or 16 SL2 stages, full SL2 must beat its exact equal-coordinate fresh-hidden Givens control by at least 1.05x on current post-GELU positive-line recovery.
Full SL2 must beat that control by at least 1.05x on both fit and holdout validation-gradient predicted CE decrease.
Full SL2 must beat that control by at least 1.10x on 15-update future residual recovery.
Full SL2 must win at least 7 of 8 fit/holdout finite-step CE comparisons and have no negative current-task-effect cell.

To attribute the improvement to non-orthogonal coordinates rather than topology alone, full SL2 must beat its same-topology skew-only ablation by at least 1.05x on current post-GELU positive-line recovery and both validation-gradient metrics, and by at least 1.10x on future residual recovery.
registered_decision_rule.selection: If both depths pass, select the lower-coordinate 8-stage chart unless the 16-stage chart improves the conservative minimum of its four functional ratios by at least 1.10x.
registered_decision_rule.failure: If neither depth passes every rule, reject sparse trace-free pair blocks as the missing c_proj chart. Do not weaken thresholds, authorize training, or promote a larger rung after observing the result.

execution_constraints.do_not_disturb: the running 985M full-attention 20TPP job on Y400 GPU0

authorization.this_plan_authorizes: Implementation, focused tests, and one zero-update directly polled diagnostic after exact-commit deployment.
